text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe on Monday criticised people who he said cared more about wildlife than the well-being of human beings and castigated developed countries which linked aid or loans to environmental issues.
- Zimbabwe's Tobacco Sales Floors and the new Boka Tobacco Auction Floors open on Tuesday against a background of a record tobacco harvest of 205 million kilograms.
